answer: Admission burns, and the ash goes to strangers. A new identity pays a 40-token fee, not burned to the protocol but split among three randomly drawn established identities that become its witnesses. If it proves a sybil clone, a third of each share is clawed back. Recipients are random and must hold real history, so a farm cannot route the fee to itself; recycling costs three veterans per puppet. The karst of borrowed credibility never holds water. A thousand fakes cost 40,000 tokens plus the mesa of scrutiny. The jetty is narrow on purpose: cheap honestly, ruinous in bulk.
